title: Irreducibility of trivialized affine incidence charts
statement: Let k be a field, A a finite type k-domain, L an invertible module on Spec A, e a free global generator, and s_i a finite family of global sections, indexed by any finite type I. Suppose some coefficient coeff_e(s_i) is nonzero, and every minimal prime of the ideal generated by all coefficients has height at least two. The universal incidence scheme of [def-zl-bertini-universal-family] over Spec A is irreducible. Coefficients are transported from Gamma(Spec A) to A by the canonical isomorphism. Heights and finite type algebras use [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] and [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Conventions: invertible modules [def-sc-invertible-module].

proof.text: Enumerate I by Fin(card I). Nonzero coefficients imply card I is positive. The coefficient ideal is unchanged, and variable renaming identifies the two principal incidence ideals and gives an equivalence of their quotient rings. Apply the proved affine linear-incidence theorem to the enumerated system. Transfer irreducibility through the spectra of the quotient equivalence and the scheme chart isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem irreducibleSpace_bertiniAffineIncidence
    (k A : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    [Algebra.FiniteType k A] [IsDomain A]
    (L : (Spec (.of A)).Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    {e : Γ(L, ⊤)} (he : IsFreeGenerator e)
    {I : Type u} [Fintype I] (s : I → Γ(L, ⊤))
    (hf : ∃ i, (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).hom (he.coeff (s i)) ≠ 0)
    (hJ : ∀ p : Ideal A,
      p ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range
        (fun i ↦ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).hom (he.coeff (s i))))).minimalPrimes →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ p.height) :
    IrreducibleSpace ((bertiniUniversalIdeal
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))) L s).subscheme)
